title: Hot-phenol RNA Extraction
author: Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.g89bzz6

steps.title: Prepare culture and ice
steps.instruction: Transfer 12–15 mL of culture (use 10 mL of stationary‑phase culture) to a 50 mL conical tube and add 25 mL of ice to slow transcription.

steps.title: Pellet cells and freeze
steps.instruction: Immediately pellet the culture at ~10,000×g, 4 °C for 10 min; discard the supernatant, flash‑freeze the pellet in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C until extraction.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet and add hot phenol
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen pellet, resuspend in 600 µL solution A (0.5 % SDS, 20 mM sodium acetate, 10 mM EDTA in RNase‑free water) and vortex; add 500 µL acid phenol:chloroform pre‑heated to 65 °C, vortex, then incubate at 65 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge to separate phases
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 21,000×g (or the maximum speed of a benchtop microcentrifuge) at room temperature for 10 min and carefully remove the aqueous supernatant.

steps.title: Second phenol and chloroform extractions
steps.instruction: Extract the recovered supernatant with 500 µL hot acid phenol:chloroform (no incubation). Then perform two successive extractions with 400 µL chloroform each to remove residual phenol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL hot acid phenol:chloroform, vortex, centrifuge and collect supernatant (no incubation).
Add 400 µL chloroform, vortex, centrifuge; repeat a second chloroform extraction.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the final supernatant to a clean tube, add 2.5 vol ice‑cold 100 % ethanol, mix, and place at –80 °C for at least 15 min (samples may be stored longer under these conditions).

steps.title: Pellet RNA and ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 21,000×g (or maximum) at 4 °C for 30 min; decant the liquid. Add 400 µL 70 % ethanol, dislodge the pellet from the tube wall (do not fully resuspend), centrifuge at maximum speed for 15 min, carefully aspirate the ethanol and air‑dry the pellet completely.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA in water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried RNA pellet in approximately 50 µL RNase‑free water (adjust volume according to expected yield and desired concentration).

steps.title: DNase treatment and cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 50 µg of RNA to a total volume of 85 µL RNase‑free water, then add 10 µL Turbo DNA‑free 10× buffer and 5 µL Turbo DNase; incubate at 37 °C for 20 min. Bring the volume to 200 µL with RNase‑free water, add 200 µL phenol:chloroform and extract once as described above. To the aqueous phase add 20 µL 3 M sodium acetate and 750 µL 100 % ethanol and precipitate RNA as in the ethanol‑precipitation step.

substeps.instruction: Adjust RNA to 85 µL with RNase‑free water.
Add Turbo DNA‑free buffer and DNase; incubate 37 °C 20 min.
Bring volume to 200 µL, add phenol:chloroform, vortex and extract.
Add sodium acetate and ethanol, then precipitate as in step 6.

steps.title: Final phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and extract the RNA with room‑temperature phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to eliminate remaining protein; repeat one or two times until the preparation is clear of protein contamination.
